breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the conflicting grid definitions. The incomplete prompt contained a general 'Grid convention' paragraph with two different interpretations, and then a specific, incorrect instruction ('interpret Nx as the number of grid points... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)'). The agent correctly ignored all of this contradictory preamble and instead used the correct definition provided later in the prompt's 'Numerical method requirements' section ('uniform periodic grid with Nx=256 points... dx=1/Nx'). This matches the approach taken by the ground truth.
